name: Shitai x Shitai x Shitai
source: Our protagonist has just finalized a divorce and his ex-wife left him custody of their step-daughter, Chizuri. One day while he was visiting her room she stopped him, asking for him to spend some time with her. Since she had been rather cold to him until this point, he obliged. Their time together turned to touching, then to kissing, then...
translation: 主角刚办完离婚手续，前妻把继女千樱里留给他抚养。一天，他去她房间时，她叫住了他，请求他陪自己待一会儿。由于她此前一直对他相当冷淡，他答应了。两人的相处逐渐变成了抚摸，接着是接吻，然后……
